title: Flat change of the final coefficient ring of universal tensor models
statement: Let R,A,B,E,D be commutative rings, A and B R-algebras, E and D algebras over T=A⊗_R B. Let k:E→D be flat and compatible with their T-algebra maps. Let phi:A→E be the composite. For a complex M of A-modules and arbitrary universal tensor cohomology models m over E and n over D [def-pc-base-derived-tensor-cohomology-model], put C=E⊗_A M, CD=D⊗_A M, and F=extension along k. Their comparison maps aE and aD are the existing affine module maps [def-pc-affine-base-change-tilde-coordinates] with identity ordinary target. There exists e:F(E⊗_T H_m^i)≅D⊗_T H_n^i such that for every chain iso tau:F(C)≅CD fixing 1⊗(1⊗x) as 1⊗x, F(aE) followed by inverse exact F-homology and H(tau) equals e followed by aD. The two models use the same chosen derived-category instances on R and B; no geometry or localization of the input/base appears.

proof.text: Use leftDerivedNatIso for the universal counits. Conjugate its homology by the two cohomologyIso maps. Naturality at a times identity and cohomologyIso_smul show A-linearity as well as B-linearity; tensor induction lifts the isomorphism to T-modules. comparison_eq and the counit identity give s.hom followed by n.comparison equals m.comparison. This is fully proved in ordinaryModelComparisonIso. The private tensorAdditiveLift argument works for additive maps with both factor-action equations in an independent module universe, then specializes to the two B-linear morphisms.

Extend s first to E and then to D. Flatten the nested extension by extendScalarsComp and transport the equal T-to-D maps. The resulting e sends 1 tensor (1 tensor x) to 1 tensor s(x), by the explicit tensor formula.

Transport the ordinary D-complex along equality of the coefficient maps and apply flatIteratedScalarExtension_homology_square to the two ordinaryToLocalized maps, their generator formulas and localized_eq equations. Postcompose with homology of the coefficient-map transport. This gives the claimed square.

theorem exists_flatFinalCoefficientModelComparison
    (R A B E D : Type u)
    [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [CommRing E] [CommRing D]
    [Algebra R A] [Algebra R B]
    [Algebra (A ⊗[R] B) E] [Algebra (A ⊗[R] B) D]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (ModuleCat.{u} R)]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (ModuleCat.{u} B)]
    (k : E →+* D) (hk : k.Flat)
    (hcoeff : k.comp (algebraMap (A ⊗[R] B) E) = algebraMap (A ⊗[R] B) D)
    (phi : A →+* E)
    (hphi : (algebraMap (A ⊗[R] B) E).comp
      (algebraMap A (A ⊗[R] B)) = phi)
    (M : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ)
    (m : BaseDerivedTensorCohomologyModel R A B M E)
    (n : BaseDerivedTensorCohomologyModel R A B M D) (i : ℤ) :
    let C := ((extendScalars phi).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj M
    let CD := ((extendScalars (k.comp phi)).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj M
    let F := extendScalars k
    letI := preservesFiniteLimits_extendScalars_of_flat hk
    let aE := AlgebraicGeometry.affineBaseChangeTildeModuleMap R A B E M m phi hphi i
      (C.homology i) (Iso.refl _)
    let hphiD : (algebraMap (A ⊗[R] B) D).comp
        (algebraMap A (A ⊗[R] B)) = k.comp phi := by rw [← hcoeff, RingHom.comp_assoc, hphi]
    let aD := AlgebraicGeometry.affineBaseChangeTildeModuleMap R A B D M n
      (k.comp phi) hphiD i (CD.homology i) (Iso.refl _)
    ∃ e : F.obj (AlgebraicGeometry.affineBaseChangeTildeModule R A B E M m i) ≅
        AlgebraicGeometry.affineBaseChangeTildeModule R A B D M n i,
      ∀ tau : (F.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj C ≅ CD,
        (∀ (j : ℤ) (x : M.X j),
          tau.hom.f j ((1 : D) ⊗ₜ[E, k] ((1 : E) ⊗ₜ[A, phi] x)) =
            (1 : D) ⊗ₜ[A, k.comp phi] x) →
        F.map aE ≫ ((C.sc i).mapHomologyIso F).inv ≫
            HomologicalComplex.homologyMap tau.hom i = e.hom ≫ aD
